independentSourceFindings.summary: Source review retained published temperature, duration, discharge-rate, operating-mode and component/package conditions. It held unbound hardware revisions, conflicting cable/connector ratings, ambiguous panel thermal coefficients, unsupported SCCR and apparent-power fields, and discharge ratings lacking explicit continuous duty. Prior SuperPack NG continuous-discharge values remain unchanged where a new manual specifies a timed condition. Integration additionally holds 16 nominal battery-voltage rows rejected against current voltage anchors and three qualified Ah rows that would suppress existing calculated energy displays; their exact transcriptions remain in the audit. Safe complementary rows import without changing guards or runtime code.
sourceDecisions: Battery capacity conditions retain discharge duration, cutoff voltage and temperature. Preferred charge C-rates are not maximum charge current, and no C-rate was calculated into amperes.

SuperPack NG below-zero heating and terminal conditions remain explicit. New approximately ten-minute discharge conditions conflict with prior verified continuous labels for three variants; prior objects are retained and conflicts are durable.

Panel STC and NOCT meanings and unit-versus-pallet scope remain distinct. Canadian Solar CS6X coefficient mapping was corrected; ambiguous Philadelphia coefficient sets and conflicting Trina document revisions remain held. SunPower production-average efficiency and generic voltage/current coefficients were not recast as different metrics.

Inverter active watts and apparent VA, nominal versus maximum ratings, timed output and temperature conditions remain distinct. SMA erroneous worker kW/kVA transcriptions were independently corrected to published W/VA. Per-string operating DC current is not short-circuit current; maximum DC input power and recommended/STC array power retain separate labels.

Accessory, kit, raw-cell and standalone-inverter identities do not inherit unrelated PV or assembly ratings. Unbound Cerbo hardware, Rubix stack-count disagreement, OutBack accessory model binding, Sol-Ark revision ambiguity, and unpublished or unavailable details remain held.

Cable and connector review retains Stäubli document revision/gender/diameter/IEC-voltage disputes, EG4 per-polarity package counts, Chargeverter assembly versus connector-current scope, and exact Signature Solar cable SKU binding. Stäubli same-source duplicate split occurrences are explicitly identified.

Electrical review preserves breaker pole count, certified interrupt-rating conditions, Nader CCC-versus-UL distinctions, IMO ordering-code binding, SolaDeck current/SCCR limitations, and ABB device-supply versus external-breaker versus thermally managed-load limits.

integrationHolds.reason: Captured voltage anchors remain immutable. Individually rejected nominal battery-voltage rows are held without relabeling; safe rows in the same record are independently eligible.
integrationHolds.capacityReason: Full qualified Ah text would suppress prior explicitly calculated nominal-energy fallback in the unchanged scalar renderer. Hold complete source rows, retaining raw anchors, qualifiers and prior displayed calculations; no synthesized energy or runtime change.

captureLimitations: Native pagination is non-atomic. Three identical full product rows and eight identical full offer rows were deduplicated with occurrence ledgers; no conflicting versions, prior captured product IDs or captured offer-linked product IDs were missing.
Only 5464 complete readable product values were eligible; 3885 truncated values were excluded whole. No truncated engineering data was reconstructed and selectors are not price imports.

All299 selected identities match the current complete capture. A new eg4-ll-s identity conflict outside the selected queue preserves existing evidence and increases the cumulative identity-hold count to64.
researchLimitations: Connected web references could misroute during concurrent research. Independent reviews reopened exact full URLs, checked canonical model/document identity, and excluded misrouted results.
Two malformed null-URL OUPES supplement input records remain immutable in the original occurrence ledger and were independently held; no null-URL record enters accepted evidence.
Unavailable sources, unpublished ratings, unsupported fields and unresolved conflicts remain explicit dispositions. This batch does not claim complete catalog coverage.

formattingReview.scope: Evidence formatting and unchanged-parser behavior only; six independent source reviews provide source verification. No source-review artifacts, normalizer, canonical data or runtime code were modified by this reviewer.
semanticFindings: Numeric panel cell arrangements map to cellCount. Additional construction/type/technology rows use only explicit source wording, retaining the complete source clause; STC and panel variants remain unchanged.

Active W and apparent VA remain distinct. Mixed W/VA evidence keeps both labels and temperature/load qualifications; standalone apparent-power occurrences remain explicit holds. Timed surge, selectable output voltages/frequencies and all tolerances survive.

Battery Ah preserves per-cell/per-unit scope, discharge rates, temperature and cutoff conditions. No C-rate-to-amp, Ah-to-energy or pack multiplication was introduced. Bare maximum discharge does not acquire continuous duty; preferred charge/discharge guidance remains distinct.

PV/DC battery-input/AC output voltage and current meanings remain explicit. SMA per-string current retains the applicable 208/240 VAC columns; recommended/STC array power remains separately labelled from maximum DC power. Six combiner strings do not become six MPPT trackers.
ABB device supply current, external supply-breaker rating and temperature-dependent managed-load line limits remain individually qualified; no aggregate current or pole count is calculated.

Component/connector/fuse/busbar scope, mating status, nominal/max/thermal ratings, pair/package quantities, wire length versus gauge, and diameter versus three-dimensional size remain explicit. Pytes values now correctly identify busbar ratings without inferring piece/pair ampacity.

Whole product and offer rows are retained by exact ID; only byte-equivalent structured row duplicates may be deduplicated in the initial pass, with every duplicate recorded. Any bounded reconciliation pass is recorded separately, with the later whole row version used without reconstructing JSON.

reconciliationPass.reason: Initial capture has three identical product-row duplicates and eight identical offer-row duplicates. All prior captured product IDs and every current captured offer-linked product ID are present. Whole-row identical duplicates are explicitly deduplicated; there are no conflicting versions or known missing linked IDs requiring an additional scan. Capture remains non-atomic and may omit contemporaneous insertions.

currentCatalogCapture.scope: Research capture only; no product, price, offer, observation or runtime database writes. Multiple reads are non-atomic and cannot guarantee that every contemporaneous catalog insertion was captured.

integrationReview.scope: Independent fixed-baseline specification integration, exact source row decision trace, immutable prior evidence, raw native capture, cumulative queue and repository scope review for Batch 36.
limitations: Capture consists of multiple native connector reads and is non-atomic; truncated product JSON is excluded rather than reconstructed.

This reviewer independently recomputed source-decision provenance and engineering mappings. Independent paired source reviewers reopened the supporting pages; this integration review does not claim a second complete live-web reopening of all citations.
Test, typecheck and build execution are recorded by the root validation artifact; this read-only verifier checks their retained artifact when supplied and does not rerun that suite.
The canonical review document embeds this report after verification and is excluded from input hashes to avoid self-reference.

engineeringReview.scope: Independently inspected every added technical field, every new panel electrical/efficiency rating, all changed runtime numeric projections, every normalization rule, rearranged value, additional projection, same-source merge and explicit unsupported/collision hold against the approved original rows and source-decision provenance. Live citations were reopened by the paired source reviewers; this review does not claim another complete live-web reopening.

resolvedFindings.finding: The unchanged parser would label these bare maximum-discharge rows as maximum continuous discharge without source-established continuous duty.
resolvedFindings.resolution: All four exact source rows are explicit durable normalization holds. Separate PowMr rows with independently approved continuous-duty wording remain eligible. No ambiguous bare maximum is promoted into a continuous numeric rating.

resolvedFindings.finding: Qualified 100/150/200 Ah source text caused the unchanged strict scalar renderer to suppress prior calculated nominal energy values of 1.28/1.92/2.56 kWh.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The three qualified Ah rows are explicit compatibility holds with full original transcriptions preserved. Raw anchors and all three prior rendered energy values remain intact. No qualifiers were stripped, no energy was synthesized, and no runtime code changed. Independent comparison recomputation finds zero lost displayed values.

resolvedFindings.finding: Sixteen nominal battery-voltage rows conflict with captured voltage anchors under the existing importer guard and could cause entire source records to be rejected.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Those exact rows are explicit holds with the guard reason and listing identity. The remaining independently approved safe rows import through the unchanged guard. Raw voltage anchors and prior specification identities remain intact; no row is relabeled to bypass the guard.

resolvedFindings.finding: The normalization qualifier called the published Pytes busbar ratings connector ratings.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final current and voltage values explicitly say maximum published busbar ratings, preserving 300 A and the separate 52 VDC or 300 VAC alternatives without a continuous-current or doubled-pair claim.

engineeringChecks: All newly retained panel conditions remain exact. STC/front-side/no-rear-gain statements, per-module rather than pallet scope, production-average efficiency and reference-value limitations remain explicit. No NOCT/NMOT electrical values are synthesized from temperature ratings. Numeric cell count, cell construction, N-type and named technology are split only when each appears in the approved source row.

Capacity rows retain Ah versus Wh units, 20-hour and temperature conditions, discharge-duration percentages, end voltages, constant-current versus constant-power qualifications and per-cell versus four-cell listing scope. No raw Ah anchor changes. Relative-capacity-only, C-rate peak-current and recommended-charge guidance remain held rather than calculated into amps or absolute maxima.

Continuous, pulse and time-limited charge/discharge remain distinct. Victron NG maximum continuous current retains C-rate and temperature text; pulse ratings retain ten-second durations. Gigastack keeps 1000 A for 0.5 ms separate from 200 A for 10 ms, and 70 A continuous charge separate from 80 A for 30 minutes. Three pre-existing SuperPack NG current/duty conflicts remain exact durable source holds; preservation is not an endorsement of those older ratings.

Battery input ranges remain separate from nominal battery voltages and PV limits. AC active watts remain separate from apparent VA, surge, temperature derating, crest-factor and power-factor conditions. Selectable voltages/frequencies and inverter-mode qualifications remain explicit. Existing scalar projections do not consume these qualified values.

SMA 208/240 VAC model columns retain their paired current, operating-voltage, active/apparent power and nominal-condition meanings. Maximum DC input power and recommended array power at module STC remain separately labeled. One independent MPP input is not confused with six strings. Feed-in and connection phases retain their distinct labels.

Operating PV input current, PV short-circuit limits and battery-charger output current remain separate. Renogy's newly projected 25 A operating input current traces to the approved manual row; its separate 25 A short-circuit limit remains a separate field. No Isc value is relabeled as operating current.

Circuit breaker current, interrupt capacity, thermal current, supply current, external supply breaker size, managed-line thermal limits and accessory component ratings preserve their published scopes. ABB individual line limits are not summed into aggregate panel ampacity. Nader 100 A per breaker and retailer-described paired 200 A configuration remain explicitly distinct. Enclosure SCCR and managed-circuit count remain held rather than becoming interrupt capacity or product poles.

Compatible conductor gauge/construction, cable gland diameter and cutting-tool capacity remain compatibility facts, not supplied wire specifications. Cable lengths retain per-cable/per-spool quantities and communication-versus-power scope. Connector current, mated/unmated ingress conditions, the Stäubli spacer-ring requirement, manufacturer-only mating compatibility and conditional assembly certifications remain explicit.

Bluetooth in a separately purchased BMS is not attributed to the battery. Battery BMS M8 interfaces, shunt/display wire length, head-unit IP55 versus shunt scope, optional Wi-Fi and unsupported communications remain clearly qualified. Protection alarm/shutdown thresholds do not become operating-voltage ranges.

All rearrangements preserve published numeric meanings, signs, units and conditions. Numeric-first transformations, written two-pole to 2 poles and removal of a numeric thousands separator perform no engineering conversion. Additional rows repeat only facts explicitly present in the same approved row. Same-source combined fields preserve every contributing condition and original metadata; cross-source collisions remain explicit holds.

All ten changed numeric projections were enumerated and traced to exact approved rows: six current projections and four SSG panel electrical values. Conditioned ratings remain text where the existing scalar parser excludes them. No capacity, price, offer, pack quantity or identity anchor is overwritten.
engineeringReview.conditionLimit: The unchanged panel parser stores conventional/front-side electrical ratings in its default stc bucket. Published condition text is preserved; no new claim is made that every retailer measurement explicitly specifies laboratory STC.
remainingScopeLimits: Unsupported fields, source conflicts, guard conflicts and the three comparison compatibility holds remain pending research evidence rather than silently discarded facts.
The review establishes faithful integration of independently approved source transcriptions; source reviewers, rather than this integration reviewer, reopened every cited page.
